Can BYD destroy Tata & Mahindra in India’s EV race?
In today’s video, we explore a powerful business battle that could reshape the Indian automobile industry — China’s EV giant BYD vs India’s homegrown titans Tata Motors and Mahindra Electric.

🛑 Who is BYD and why is everyone talking about it?
BYD (Build Your Dreams) is a Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer that has become a global leader in EV technology. With its advanced blade battery, massive EV production capacity, and presence in over 70 countries, BYD has now set its eyes on the Indian EV market, one of the fastest-growing electric vehicle markets in the world.

🚗 What makes BYD a threat?

BYD has already launched models like BYD Atto 3, e6, and is planning to introduce its premium EV sedan BYD Seal in India.

It controls its own battery manufacturing, giving it a competitive cost advantage.

Globally, BYD overtook Tesla in Q4 2023 in EV unit sales — a clear signal of its rising dominance.

Backed by Warren Buffett, BYD combines affordable pricing, advanced technology, and scalable production.

🇮🇳 But what about Tata and Mahindra?

Tata Motors currently dominates India’s EV space with over 80% market share, thanks to popular models like the Nexon EV, Tiago EV, and Tigor EV.

Mahindra Electric is preparing a major comeback with its Born Electric platform, and recently launched the XUV400 EV to challenge Tata.
